newsitem.title: UK: UK abandons plan to revamp Treasury building.
newsitem.headline: UK abandons plan to revamp Treasury building.

text.p: Plans to redevelop the main building of the Treasury have fallen foul of government spending curbs, a junior Treasury minister announced on Thursday.
Geoffrey Robinson said in a written parliamentary answer that Chancellor Gordon Brown had decided to terminate negotiations on the project with Exchequer Partnership Plc.

"At a time when all departments are undertaking comprehensive spending reviews and are subject to extremely tight expenditure controls, the Chancellor of the Exchequer was unwilling to embark on a major construction partner of this scale," Robinson said.

"The plans to refurbish the main Treasury building under the Private Finance Initiative represented good value for money in their own terms, but Ministers judged they had to have regard to wider considerations."
